translations.web: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
translations.bsb: Nothing is better for a man than to eat and drink and enjoy his work. I have also seen that this is from the hand of God.
